jobs.name: Security & RBAC Posture Audit
jobs.prompt: Run the daily fleet security and RBAC posture audit. Read the SOP at 'governance/compliance_audit_sop.md' in your profile home — all 406 lines of it, before you run anything. Its eleven checks are section 2, lines 102-314, so a read that stops early skips almost the entire audit and reports a clean fleet it never looked at. Then execute it exactly, using the fleet-audit skill to open and close the audit run.

jobs.name: AI Workload Security Audit
jobs.prompt: Run the daily AI workload security audit. Read the SOP at 'governance/ai_security_audit_sop.md' in your profile home — all 342 lines of it, before you run anything. Its six checks are section 3, lines 148-272, so a read that stops early skips almost the entire audit and reports a clean fleet it never looked at. Section 2 defines which workloads count as AI workloads; on a cluster running none the six checks still ran and matched nothing, so record all six in checks_run with the collection command — never leave checks_run empty, which the validator rejects. Then execute it exactly, using the fleet-audit skill to open and close the audit run.
